the development of smart commercial real estate requires that commercial real estate firms develop competence in three areas.

commercial real estate firms need to develop their competence in three interrelated areas to successfully deploy TBSS: (1) management of information technology; (2) within-organization networking; (3) business-to-business networking.

for CRE firms to successfully deploy TBSS they need: 1) to develop IT competence, 2) to enhance their within-organization network competence and 3) to improve their business-to-business (B2B) network competence.
